# 0e SSH, tailnet, backups, deploy: contract

**Read first:** [ADR 0007](../adr/0007-agentless-ssh-with-pinned-host-keys.md), [ADR 0008](../adr/0008-tsnet-node-for-router-reachability.md), [ADR 0012](../adr/0012-secrets-encrypted-root-password-never-stored.md), [platform#ssh](../modules/platform.md#ssh), [#tailnet](../modules/platform.md#tailnet), [deployment](../deployment.md), the 0c and 0d contracts and their **As built** notes. For the drafts: `~/projects/sh-blackberry/{CLAUDE.md,README.md,compose.yaml,copyparty.yaml}`, `~/projects/sh-main/{CLAUDE.md,compose.yaml,nginx/conf.d/files.conf,headscale/}`.

**Done when:** Proxier has its SSH key from the first start and shows it in Settings → SSH; a job can run a command on a host through a jump host with both keys pinned, streaming redacted output; a changed host key stops every job with that host until **Accept new key**; the tailnet node joins headscale when an auth key is given; the nightly backup and **Back up now** write `/data/backups/proxier-YYYY-MM-DD.db` and keep 14; the infra drafts are in place, uncommitted; the Phase 0 exit demo passes on `proxier.tikhonnnnn.com`.

## Decisions

| Topic | Decision | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Proxier's key | ed25519, generated by `platform.Init` when `ssh_identity` is empty. Private key as OpenSSH PEM, sealed with AAD `ssh:identity`. Comment `proxier@<instance name>`. → `ssh.key_generated{fingerprint, regenerated: false}`. | platform.md "generated on first start". |
| Regenerate | Strength-3 dialog (type `regenerate`), naming how many known hosts exist and that each server, jump host and router needs the new key. Replaces the row → `ssh.key_generated{regenerated: true}` (notifies). | |
| Personal keys | Settings field `ssh.personal_keys` (string, up to 16,000 chars): one `authorized_keys` line per line, each must parse; blank lines and `#` comments allowed. Saved through `settings.Set`, so `settings.changed` covers it. Phase 1 installs them on new servers. | No table for a list the admin edits as text. |
| Host-key pinning | Per address (`host:port`, host lower-cased). Two first-contact modes: `PinOnFirstContact` (servers at provisioning: pinned when the handshake succeeds → `ssh.host_key_pinned`) and `ConfirmFirstContact` (routers, jump hosts: `*UnknownHostError` with the fingerprint; the UI shows it and calls `Pin`). | ADR 0007; the Add-router dialog confirms the fingerprint (ui/README). |
| Changed key | The host-key callback only compares; it never writes (the handshake is a remote call). After the refusal, one `Write` stores the new key as **pending** and records `ssh.host_key_changed{address, old, new}` **only if this pending fingerprint is new**. Every connection to that address fails with `*HostKeyChangedError` (wrapped `jobs.Permanent`) until **Accept new key** (→ `ssh.host_key_accepted`) or **Forget** (→ `ssh.host_forgotten`; the next contact is a first contact). | One notification per change, not per job; nothing reconnects until the admin acts. |
| Jump host | At most one: the jump hop connects first (same pinning rules), then the target is dialled through it (`jumpClient.DialContext`) and gets its own handshake and pin. Both hops use Proxier's key. | platform.md. |
| Networks | `Target.Network`: `Direct` (net.Dialer) or `Tailnet` (the tsnet node's `Dial`); it applies to the first hop. Tailnet off → `tailnet.ErrOff`, a permanent error with a clear message. | ADR 0008. |
| Timeouts | Dial 15 s, handshake 15 s, command 5 min default (`RunOptions.Timeout`), keepalive every 30 s (`keepalive@openssh.com`; 3 misses close). A command timeout kills the session and returns `ErrTimeout` with the exit code unknown. | Commands must never hang a job. |
| Output | `Run` streams stdout and stderr line by line into the job's `Logger` (stderr at `warn`), redacted by the logger; it also returns both, capped at 1 MiB each, **unredacted** to the step (it needs them to parse). | Redaction at the log, not at the caller. |
| Upload | SFTP (`github.com/pkg/sftp`): write `<path>.proxier-tmp`, chmod, `posix-rename@openssh.com` over the target (plain rename when the server lacks it), fsync when supported. Parent directories are not created implicitly. | Atomic replace; RouterOS SFTP is checked in Phase 3 (open question 5). |
| tsnet | `tailscale.com/tsnet`, `Dir = <data>/tailnet` (0700), `Hostname = PROXIER_TS_HOSTNAME`, `ControlURL`, `AuthKey` from env, `Ephemeral = false`, logs to slog at debug. Started in the background by `serve`; HTTP doesn't wait for it. Off without `PROXIER_TS_AUTHKEY`. Log upload to Tailscale's servers is disabled (`TS_NO_LOGS_NO_SUPPORT=true` in the image; verify the knob for the pinned version). | ADR 0008; the node only dials out. |
| Re-authenticate | Settings → Integrations → Tailnet takes a new pre-auth key (never stored), closes the node and starts it with that key. Key expiry is shown; open question 7 decides whether a non-expiring node is used. | |
| Backups | Job type `platform.backup` (maintenance, 2 attempts, backoff 15 min), steps `snapshot` (`VACUUM INTO '<data>/backups/.proxier-YYYY-MM-DD.db.tmp'`, then rename over `proxier-YYYY-MM-DD.db`) and `prune` (keep the newest `backups.keep` by name). The date is in the display time zone; a second backup on one day replaces that day's file. `OnFailed` records `backup.failed{error}` (so no `job.failed`); success records `backup.completed{file, size}`. | deployment.md. The rename makes a half-written file impossible to download. |
| Backup connection | `VACUUM INTO` runs on a dedicated connection opened for it (not `W`, which would block every write for the duration, and not `R` if `query_only` refuses it — the test decides and the As built note says which). | |
| Backup schedule | `platform.backup` at `backups.time` (default `03:30`), no jitter. **Back up now** enqueues with coalescing key `platform.backup`. | |
| Download | `GET /settings/backups/latest` streams the newest file as `proxier-YYYY-MM-DD.db` (`Content-Disposition: attachment`, `no-store`). | Secrets in it stay sealed; restoring needs the master key. |
| Healthcheck | New `proxier healthcheck`: GET `http://127.0.0.1<listen>/healthz` with a 3 s timeout, exit 0 or 1. Used by compose (the image has no curl). | Distroless. |
| Deploy drafts | Written into the infra repos as **uncommitted** changes for the user, following each repo's conventions (read its CLAUDE.md first). The tunnel is an autossh sidecar like `ssht-copyparty`, on remote port **10004** of sh-main's `ssh-server`. `PROXIER_TRUSTED_PROXIES` is the proxier compose network's fixed subnet, whose only other member is the tunnel container. | Same pattern as files.tikhonnnnn.com. |

Settings sections (new, platform):

| Key | Kind | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ssh.personal_keys` | string | `""` | authorized_keys lines |
| `backups.time` | string | `03:30` | `HH:MM`, display time zone |
| `backups.keep` | int | `14` | 1–90 |

## Tables — `internal/platform/migrations/00005_ssh.sql`

```sql
-- +goose Up

-- Proxier's own SSH key pair. One row.
CREATE TABLE ssh_identity (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
    private_key BLOB NOT NULL,   -- vault, AAD "ssh:identity"; OpenSSH PEM
    public_key  TEXT NOT NULL,   -- authorized_keys line
    fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,   -- "SHA256:…"
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

-- Pinned host keys, one per address. A changed key waits in pending_* until
-- the admin accepts it or forgets the host.
CREATE TABLE known_hosts (
    id                  INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    address             TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,   -- "host:port"
    subject             TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', -- "server:12", "router:3", "jump:parents-pi"
    key_type            TEXT NOT NULL,
    public_key          BLOB NOT NULL,          -- wire format
    fingerprint         TEXT NOT NULL,
    first_seen_at       TEXT NOT NULL,
    accepted_at         TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_used_at        TEXT,
    pending_key_type    TEXT,
    pending_public_key  BLOB,
    pending_fingerprint TEXT,
    pending_seen_at     TEXT,
    CHECK ((pending_public_key IS NULL) = (pending_fingerprint IS NULL))
) STRICT;

-- +goose Down
DROP TABLE known_hosts;
DROP TABLE ssh_identity;
```

## Go signatures

### `internal/platform/sshx`

```go
type Network int

const (
	Direct Network = iota
	Tailnet
)

type FirstContact int

const (
	PinOnFirstContact FirstContact = iota
	ConfirmFirstContact
)

type Hop struct {
	Address string // "host:port"
	User    string
	Subject string // for the known host: "server:12", "jump:parents-pi"
}

type Target struct {
	Hop
	Jump         *Hop
	Network      Network
	FirstContact FirstContact
}

type HostKeyChangedError struct{ Address, Old, New string } // fingerprints
type UnknownHostError struct {
	Address, Fingerprint string
	Key                  ssh.PublicKey
}

var (
	ErrTimeout = errors.New("sshx: command timed out")
	ErrAuth    = errors.New("sshx: the host refused Proxier's key")
)

type Dialer func(ctx context.Context, network, addr string) (net.Conn, error)

type SSH struct {
	Now func() time.Time
	// …
}

func New(d *db.DB, v *vault.Vault, ev *events.Catalog, st *settings.Store, tailnet Dialer, log *slog.Logger) *SSH

// Identity.
func (s *SSH) EnsureIdentity(ctx context.Context, instanceName string) error // first start
func (s *SSH) PublicKey(ctx context.Context) (line, fingerprint string, err error)
func (s *SSH) Regenerate(ctx context.Context, actor string) error

// Known hosts.
type KnownHost struct {
	ID                          int64
	Address, Subject            string
	KeyType, Fingerprint        string
	FirstSeenAt, AcceptedAt     db.Time
	LastUsedAt                  db.Time
	PendingFingerprint          string // "" when none
	PendingSeenAt               db.Time
}

func (s *SSH) KnownHosts(ctx context.Context) ([]KnownHost, error)
func (s *SSH) Pin(ctx context.Context, address, subject string, key ssh.PublicKey, actor string) error
func (s *SSH) Accept(ctx context.Context, id int64, actor string) error
func (s *SSH) Forget(ctx context.Context, id int64, actor string) error

// Connections.
func (s *SSH) Connect(ctx context.Context, t Target, log *jobs.Logger) (*Client, error)

type Client struct{ /* … */ }

type RunOptions struct {
	Timeout time.Duration // 0: 5 min
	Stdin   io.Reader
	Log     *jobs.Logger // nil: nothing streamed
}

type Result struct {
	ExitCode       int
	Stdout, Stderr []byte // capped at 1 MiB each, unredacted
}

func (c *Client) Run(ctx context.Context, cmd string, o RunOptions) (Result, error)
func (c *Client) Upload(ctx context.Context, path string, data []byte, mode fs.FileMode) error
func (c *Client) Close() error
```

## Routes

| Method, path | What |
|---|---|
| `GET /settings/ssh` | Public key (copy), Regenerate…, personal keys form, known hosts (address, subject, fingerprint, first seen, last used; pending → band with old/new and **Accept new key**) |
| `POST /settings/ssh/regenerate` | Strength 3 |
| `POST /settings/ssh/personal-keys` | `ssh` section |
| `POST /settings/ssh/hosts/:id/accept` | Strength 2: old and new fingerprints |
| `POST /settings/ssh/hosts/:id/forget` | Strength 2 |
| `GET /settings/integrations/tailnet` | State, node name, IP, key expiry, control URL; Re-authenticate form |
| `POST /settings/integrations/tailnet/reauth` | `authkey` (not stored) |
| `GET /settings/backups` | Schedule and keep (form), list of backups, **Back up now**, **Download latest** |
| `POST /settings/backups` | `backups` section |
| `POST /settings/backups/run` | Enqueue → the job's page |
| `GET /settings/backups/latest` | Download |

## Deploy drafts

`sh-blackberry/proxier.yaml` (shape; names and env conventions from the repo):

- `proxier`: `image: ghcr.io/tikhonp/proxier:latest`, `read_only: true`, `cap_drop: [ALL]`, `security_opt: [no-new-privileges:true]`, `user: "65532:65532"`, `tmpfs: /tmp`, the `/data` volume (named volume, or a bind path owned by 65532 as the repo does for others), `env_file` from `secrets/`, `stop_grace_period: 30s`, `healthcheck: ["CMD", "/bin/proxier", "healthcheck"]`, logging and dozzle labels like the others, no published ports, network `proxier` with a fixed `/29` subnet.
- `ssht-proxier`: `jnovack/autossh`, like `ssht-copyparty`, forwarding sh-main's `ssh-server:10004` to `proxier:8080`.
- Env: `PROXIER_MASTER_KEY`, `PROXIER_BASE_URL=https://proxier.tikhonnnnn.com`, `PROXIER_TRUSTED_PROXIES=<the /29>`, `PROXIER_TS_AUTHKEY`, `PROXIER_TZ=Europe/Moscow`.

`sh-main/nginx/conf.d/proxier.conf`: modelled on `files.conf`: `server_name proxier.tikhonnnnn.com`, upstream `ssh-server:10004`, `X-Real-IP`, `X-Forwarded-For`, `X-Forwarded-Proto`, `Host`; `client_max_body_size 10m`; `proxy_http_version 1.1`, `proxy_buffering off` and `proxy_read_timeout 1h` (SSE); `robots.txt` disallow all. The certificate is issued by the user.

Steps the user runs (listed in the final message, not done by Claude): create the DNS record, issue the certificate, `headscale preauthkeys create` for the node, generate the master key into secrets and Vaultwarden, commit both infra repos, push the image (the GitHub remote).

## Phase 0 exit demo

Run on the real deployment and write the result into the **As built** section:

1. `docker exec -it proxier /bin/proxier manage create-admin`; sign in on `https://proxier.tikhonnnnn.com` (from a new IP → Telegram 🔐).
2. Settings → Integrations → Telegram: token, Detect chat, Send test.
3. Jobs → **Run demo job** with "fail at the end"; watch the live log on a phone and a laptop.
4. Mid-count, `docker restart proxier`: the job shows `interrupted`, then resumes; the log streams again from where it was.
5. The job fails at `finish` → `job.failed` → Telegram 🔴 with **Open in Proxier** opening the job.
6. Settings → Backups → **Back up now** → **Download latest**.

## Checklist

SSH ([ADR 0007](../adr/0007-agentless-ssh-with-pinned-host-keys.md), [platform#ssh](../modules/platform.md#ssh)), in `internal/platform/sshx/`:

- [ ] First start generates the key once; a restart keeps it; private key sealed — `identity_test.go` `TestIdentityIsGeneratedOnce`
- [ ] Regenerate replaces the key and records `ssh.key_generated{regenerated: true}` — `identity_test.go` `TestRegenerateReplacesKey`
- [ ] Personal keys: a bad line refused with its line number — `identity_test.go` `TestPersonalKeysAreValidated`
- [ ] First contact with `PinOnFirstContact` pins and records `ssh.host_key_pinned` — `knownhosts_test.go` `TestFirstContactPinsHostKey`
- [ ] First contact with `ConfirmFirstContact` → `UnknownHostError` with the fingerprint, nothing pinned; after `Pin` it connects — `knownhosts_test.go` `TestFirstContactNeedsConfirmation`
- [ ] Changed key → every connection fails with `HostKeyChangedError`; one `ssh.host_key_changed` for repeated attempts — `knownhosts_test.go` `TestChangedHostKeyStopsEveryConnection`
- [ ] Accept new key → connects; `ssh.host_key_accepted` — `knownhosts_test.go` `TestAcceptNewKey`
- [ ] Forget → next contact is a first contact — `knownhosts_test.go` `TestForgetHost`
- [ ] Through a jump host: both hops pinned, command runs on the target — `client_test.go` `TestJumpHostPinsBothHops`
- [ ] Changed key on the jump hop stops the connection — `client_test.go` `TestJumpHostKeyChangeStops`
- [ ] Wrong authorized key → `ErrAuth` — `client_test.go` `TestRefusedKey`
- [ ] Command over its timeout → `ErrTimeout`, session closed — `client_test.go` `TestCommandTimeout`
- [ ] Output streamed line by line into the job log, redacted; the step gets it unredacted — `client_test.go` `TestRunStreamsRedactedOutput`
- [ ] Exit code returned for a failing command — `client_test.go` `TestRunReturnsExitCode`
- [ ] Upload replaces atomically with the mode — `client_test.go` `TestUploadReplacesAtomically`
- [ ] Tailnet network while the tailnet is off → `tailnet.ErrOff` — `client_test.go` `TestTailnetTargetWhileOff`

Tailnet, in `internal/platform/tailnet/tailnet_test.go`:

- [ ] Without an auth key: state `off`, `Dial` → `ErrOff`, nothing created in the data dir — `TestTailnetOffWithoutAuthKey`
- [ ] (manual, recorded in As built) joins headscale as `proxier`, reaches a jump host; restart keeps the node without the key being used again

Backups, in `internal/platform/backup/backup_test.go`:

- [ ] Snapshot is a valid database with the same rows; secrets still sealed and open with the master key — `TestBackupIsAConsistentCopy`
- [ ] 15 days of backups → 14 kept, oldest removed — `TestBackupKeepsFourteen`
- [ ] Second backup on one day replaces that day's file — `TestSameDayBackupReplaces`
- [ ] No `.tmp` file is ever listed or downloaded — `TestHalfWrittenBackupIsInvisible`
- [ ] Failure records `backup.failed` and no `job.failed`; success records `backup.completed` — `TestBackupEvents`
- [ ] Schedule follows `backups.time` in the display zone — `TestBackupScheduleFollowsSetting`
- [ ] Writes keep working while a backup runs — `TestBackupDoesNotBlockWrites`

Pages and commands:

- [ ] Accept and Forget need CSRF and show the fingerprints — `pages/ssh_test.go` `TestKnownHostActions`
- [ ] Download latest: attachment, `no-store`, 404 when none — `pages/backups_test.go` `TestDownloadLatest`
- [ ] `proxier healthcheck` exits 0 on a healthy server, 1 otherwise — `cmd/proxier/main_test.go` `TestHealthcheckCommand`
